info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Groups API
Get a list of all Groups

params.name: group_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of requested UUID group IDs

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

params.name: carrier_id
params.description: Used for filtering for a carrier-specific group ID. Must be used with carrier_group_id.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Used for filtering for organization-specific groups

params.name: carrier_group_id
params.description: Used for filtering for a carrier-specific group ID. Must be used with carrier_id.

params.name: company
params.description: Searches groups for name or dba_name values that contain the search term

params.name: name_starts_with
params.description: Searches groups for name or dba_name values that start with the search term

items.docs: Returns a list of all groups
